rulings.barItem: a stated cause that never happens, and a promise never kept
rulings.reason: Step 2 is named 'A repeat boot reads the same key', but the life has no repeat boot: it runs without a break from step 0 to step 24. The outline's act 7 ('Resume and read the same catalog/key/bytes without reseeding') is never performed by any step; the life ends on refusals.
rulings.correction: Move step 2 after step 24, behind a wait (for example `1d`) and the World's resume. Follow it with the restarted helper's startup catalog fetch (www.googleapis.com/webfonts/v1/webfonts?sort=popularity&key={key}) and one download of a stored font URL, with no reseed. Alternatively, delete step 2 and act 7.

rulings.barItem: a refusal without a cause the story shows, or the same cause drawn twice; a run of refusals
rulings.reason: Step 3 (no key, 403) and step 4 (key=not-issued, 400) are two refusals in a row that no actor causes. The developer API page requires the key on every request (https://developers.google.com/fonts/docs/developer_api: 'including an API key with each request'), and the pinned helper always sends the World's issued key (demand.json, fetchGoogleFonts.ts:62). Nobody in the story sends a request without one or with a foreign key.

rulings.barItem: a read-back with no need: a list or get of what the story already holds, unless someone who does not hold it reads it
rulings.reason: Step 6 reads the same catalog again through the Discovery base webfonts.googleapis.com/v1/webfonts directly after step 5 returned it. No application in demand.json calls that host, and the reader already holds the catalog; the step only shows that a second door exists.

rulings.barItem: a read-back with no need: a list or get of what the story already holds, unless someone who does not hold it reads it
rulings.reason: Step 19 repeats step 17's CSS2 request for Inter wght@600 under User-Agent 'undici'. Dub's Open Graph route is the only CSS2 caller and already holds that stylesheet from step 17. No actor in the story sends 'undici'; that the two agents get the same answer is recorded in vendor/inter.json, not an act of the story.

rulings.barItem: vendor behaviour the vendor's documentation contradicts
rulings.reason: Step 20 expects 400 when Chrome requests css2?family=Inter:wght@600. Google documents the CSS API as a stylesheet link 'add[ed] to your HTML document' that the browser fetches (https://developers.google.com/fonts/docs/getting_started; https://developers.google.com/fonts/docs/css2 uses the same link form), and Google answers a browser with a stylesheet. No browser acts anywhere in this story, so the refusal also has no cause.

rulings.barItem: vendor behaviour the vendor's documentation contradicts
rulings.reason: Step 21 expects 400 for Rallly's demanded request css2?family=Noto+Sans+SC:wght@700&text=%E6%8A%95%E7%A5%A8 (demand.json, opengraph-image.tsx:26-27). Google documents that text= "also works for international fonts, allowing you to specify UTF-8 characters" (https://developers.google.com/fonts/docs/css2; https://developers.google.com/fonts/docs/getting_started), so Google answers this request with a truetype stylesheet. The life's title and outline name Rallly as a customer, yet Rallly's only call is refused.
rulings.correction: Publish Google's retained CSS2 answer for this query and its truetype file in step 0. Then have step 21 expect 200 with that CSS, followed by Rallly downloading the returned URL. Alternatively, remove Rallly from the life and its outline.

rulings.barItem: a refusal without a cause the story shows, or the same cause drawn twice; a run of refusals
rulings.reason: Steps 20 to 24 end the life with five refusals in a row. No actor causes the last three. Step 22 sends text= twice; css2 says "the 'text=' parameter can only be specified once" (https://developers.google.com/fonts/docs/css2), but Dub sends no text= and Rallly sends one. Step 23 fetches a gstatic path that no returned CSS named. Step 24 asks /css for an unknown family with no User-Agent, and its name ('Unsupported CSS representation') does not describe that content.

rulings.why: Move step 2 after step 24, behind a wait (for example `1d`) and the World's resume. Follow it with the restarted helper's startup catalog fetch (www.googleapis.com/webfonts/v1/webfonts?sort=popularity&key={key}) and one download of a stored font URL, with no reseed. Alternatively, delete step 2 and act 7.

Publish Google's retained CSS2 answer for this query and its truetype file in step 0. Then have step 21 expect 200 with that CSS, followed by Rallly downloading the returned URL. Alternatively, remove Rallly from the life and its outline.
